title.en: An Act Establishing a High School in the Municipality of Naguilian, Province of La Union, to Be Known as the Naguilian High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông tại Thị trấn Naguilian, Tỉnh La Union được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông Naguilian
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาในเทศบาล Naguilian, จังหวัด La Union ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Naguilian

text.en: There shall be established a high school in the Municipality of Naguilian, Province of La Union, to be known as the Naguilian High School.
The Secretary of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act is hereby authorized to be appropriated in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
